stance_rationale: Forge draft is not approvable because the PASS claim uses S1 BASE_RAW instead of the request's M4-relative baseline, while mandatory DSR/Harvey gates are absent and the forward May 2026 sizing is not in canonical weights.csv. This is a rejection stance only; veto_flag remains false.

critical_concerns.description: Decision-rule PASS is baseline-inverted: request requires MDD <=25% or M4-relative 3pp improvement, but M4+DCC MDD is 33.39% vs L-274 M4-only 32.05%, worse by 1.34pp; the draft instead claims PASS using S1 BASE_RAW 41.69%.

Stock-level walk-forward inheritance is not evidenced: target alpha_scores.parquet path is missing, parent holdings file is sleeve/cash only with max 2 rows per date, and current weights.csv is sleeve-level only, so max_names, per-name cap, and stock-level rebalancing cannot be verified in this forge artifact.

Forward May 2026 operational claim is not in canonical schedule: package reports scale_factor 0.4194 and cash 58.06%, but weights.csv ends at 2026-03-01 with weight_str1715 0.4779 and cash 52.21%; the May 2026 backtest row uses the older 52.21% cash exposure.

Mandatory Harvey/DSR evidence is absent: no CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, FF6 t_NW results, no DSR, and no consistent candidates_tried penalty despite observable 4 risk candidates plus 3 optimizer variants.

covariance.parquet passes PSD but fails the requested condition-number bound: reconstructed daily 18x18 covariance has max condition 240.87 with 13 dates above 100, while the package only reports PSD and selected-slice condition.
Pure Function audit omits alpha_package.json from pre/post hashes, so the required 3-package md5 audit is incomplete even though risk_package and optimization_package hashes match.

Rationalization flag detected: 'NEGLIGIBLE' is used for SR provenance divergence, and the 15% fixed vol target is described as not unilateral despite challenge notes admitting de facto conservative bias.

supporting_arguments: Risk/optimizer/package hashes for audited files match the package pre/post values; no direct run_all.R write to risk_package.json or optimization_package.json was found.
weights.csv has 267 unique monthly dates from 2004-01-01 to 2026-03-01 and sleeve-level sum-to-one/long-only checks pass.
Chart files equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, oos_zoom_chart.png, and regime_decomposition.png are present; run_all.R draws the lockbox marker and strategy lines through 2026-05.
Round-trip transaction cost is implemented as abs(delta weight) x 2 x 15bps; RF-F7 is not triggered.
unresolved_disputes: Whether sizing_only can waive stock-level forge verification when the cited parent output is also sleeve-level.
Whether L-274 M4-only should be the binding baseline; the request text says M4-relative, but the draft's PASS uses S1 BASE_RAW.
Whether DSR/Harvey gates are explicitly exempt for this recommendation_only sizing WT; no exemption is documented in the forge prompt schema.
Whether covariance condition <=100 is required for all 928 slices or only the final operational slice; user request says covariance.parquet post-shrink condition <=100.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that S1 BASE_RAW is a valid baseline for the M4-relative decision rule; using the actual L-274 M4-only reference removes the claimed MDD PASS.
rebuttal_required: Provide same-period, same-cost, same-DSR-penalty M4-only recomputation and show M4+DCC meets the request's M4-relative decision rule.
Add canonical May 2026 forward row or separate operational weights artifact matching the stated 0.4194/0.5806 sizing, with PIT lag semantics documented.
Produce or cite stock-level Date x Ticker x weight walk-forward evidence, not sleeve/cash placeholder holdings.
Run or formally waive DSR plus 5-spec Harvey regressions with candidate penalty applied consistently to strategy and baseline.
Explain covariance condition breaches above 100 or regenerate post-shrink covariance satisfying the bound.
rationalization_red_flags: fixed 15pct heuristic ceiling framed as not unilateral

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Forge self-PASS plus waiver language is insufficient because the independent checks fail baseline fairness, DSR/Harvey completeness, forward-weight lineage, and covariance condition requirements.

forge_specific_questions: Pure Function v6.1 R12 hash audit PRE=POST is incomplete because alpha_package.json is omitted.
Walk-forward is multi-date at sleeve level, but stock-level walk-forward and target alpha_scores path are not verified.
Lockbox strategy NAV appears present in charts, but it is a sleeve proxy and uses older weights for May 2026.
Baseline comparison is not same-period same-cost same-DSR-penalty for the mandated M4 reference.
